pois.name: Jalan Kemang Raya
pois.description: The spine of Jakarta's most cosmopolitan neighbourhood — 2km of boutique restaurants, art galleries, concept stores, and rooftop bars catering to Jakarta's international community and creative class.

pois.name: Kemang Village
pois.description: Integrated lifestyle complex — a mall, luxury serviced residences, and The Ritz-Carlton Kemang Hotel. The centrepiece of Kemang's upscale redevelopment and the neighbourhood's tallest landmark at 36 floors.

pois.name: Kemang Art Galleries
pois.description: A cluster of contemporary art galleries anchoring Kemang's reputation as Jakarta's creative hub — including Ruci Art Space, SaladStop!, and several pop-up concept stores in converted villa spaces.

pois.name: Kemang Food Scene
pois.description: Kemang's dense strip of international restaurants spanning Japanese omakase, Italian trattorias, and Indonesian fusion — one of Jakarta's best concentrations of quality dining per block.
